
Panel F is the union of species that are core in either Charging Bull or Fearless Girl, where core means presence in at least 75% of that monument's retained samples. There are `r fig4_core$n_core` such species: `r fig4_core$n_both` are core in both statues, `r fig4_core$n_fg_only` only in Fearless Girl, and `r fig4_core$n_cb_only` only in Charging Bull. The fill is the percentage of samples at that location in which the species was detected. The first column is the pooled US metal group of the main figures, followed by the two Fearless Girl locations and the three Charging Bull locations. An asterisk, on the species name and in the US metal column, means that the species was on the original pooled US metal core list: present in at least 75% of Charging Bull and Fearless Girl samples taken together (`r fig4_core$n_starred` species). Species that are core on only one statue, and fall below 75% once the two statues are pooled, are shown without an asterisk.

The combined figure is two pages: `paper_output/Figure5_human_reads_cbfg` (A–E) and `paper_output/Figure5_core_species_heatmap` (F), each as `.pdf` and `.png`. Saved panels are in `paper_output/Figure5/`: `Figure5A_human_reads_by_monument.png`, `Figure5B_richness_vs_human_reads.png`, `Figure5C_samples_per_location.png`, `Figure5D_human_reads_by_location.png`, `Figure5E_shared_taxa_venns.png` (the three Venn diagrams together), and `Figure5F_core_species_heatmap.png`.

# Figure 6. Literature-associated genera on the focal monuments

Panel A stacks the MetaPhlAn genus abundances for the named genera in `input/Literature_Microorganism.csv`, which is sheet 1 of the validated table. *Cutibacterium* is on that sheet but marked as not recommended for inclusion, so it is left out. *Bryobacter* is only an unverified aside on the *Blastocatella* row, so it is left out. A genus is drawn only when its abundance is above zero in at least one focal swab. Genera that are on the list but absent from these swabs are left out of the bars and out of the legend. The values are the original MetaPhlAn relative abundances. Genera are not rebuilt from species, and the profiles are not renormalized, so a bar at 25% means those listed genera make up 25% of that sample’s full MetaPhlAn profile. Each bar is one retained sample, and samples with none of the listed genera are omitted. Each monument has its own panel and its own y-axis, because the totals differ. The same genus keeps the same color in every panel. The most abundant genera get the most widely separated colors. Panel names use a hyphen, because an em dash was printing as a missing character.

Panel B is the same genus list and the same monuments. A genus is counted as present when its abundance is above zero in at least one sample from that monument. The upper bars count how many listed genera are shared by each combination of monuments. The lower bars count how many listed genera were detected in each monument.

```{r figure6, fig.width=16, fig.height=20, out.width="100%"}
FIG6_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure6")

literature_genera <- literature_genera_from_sheet(file.path(ROOT, "input", "Literature_Microorganism.csv"))
distinct_genus_colors <- function(genera) {
  # Named colors, farthest apart first. Pass genera with the largest
  # abundances first. No second pink, green, or yellow at a similar lightness.
  palette <- c(
    "#111111", "#E10600", "#1A33FF", "#FFD000", "#008F2F", "#D10070",
    "#FF6A00", "#00CFFF", "#A33B1E", "#6A1B9A", "#0A1860", "#006E68",
    "#6E1030", "#8A8A8A", "#E8C9A2", "#FFB0C8", "#D4A6FF", "#F99379",
    "#654522", "#A1CAF1", "#2F4F4F", "#BC8F8F", "#5C6B7A", "#4C005C",
    "#94FFB5", "#990000", "#4682B4", "#2B3D26", "#7B68EE", "#C2B280",
    "#20B2AA", "#806000"
  )
  if (length(genera) > length(palette)) {
    stop("Need more distinct genus colors than the palette provides.")
  }
  setNames(palette[seq_along(genera)], genera)
}

fig5_sample_key <- focal_sample_key %>%
  mutate(
    monument_display = plot_label(str_replace_all(as.character(monument), "_", " ")),
    fig5_panel = paste(monument_display, materials_plot, sep = " - "),
    focal_group = factor(focal_group, levels = FOCAL_GROUP_LEVELS)
  ) %>%
  distinct(sample_name_clean, focal_group, materials_plot, monument_display, fig5_panel)

fig5_panel_order <- fig5_sample_key %>%
  arrange(focal_group, fig5_panel) %>%
  distinct(fig5_panel) %>%
  pull(fig5_panel)

fig5_genus <- metaphlan_long %>%
  filter(
    rank == "genus",
    sample_name_clean %in% fig5_sample_key$sample_name_clean,
    taxon %in% literature_genera
  ) %>%
  inner_join(fig5_sample_key %>% select(sample_name_clean, fig5_panel), by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  transmute(sample_name_clean, fig5_panel, genus = taxon, abundance)

literature_genera <- names(sort(tapply(fig5_genus$abundance, fig5_genus$genus, sum), decreasing = TRUE))
genus_labels <- setNames(str_replace_all(literature_genera, "_", " "), literature_genera)
LITERATURE_GENUS_COLORS <- distinct_genus_colors(literature_genera)
stopifnot(
  length(LITERATURE_GENUS_COLORS) == length(literature_genera),
  anyDuplicated(unname(LITERATURE_GENUS_COLORS)) == 0
)

fig5_sample_order <- fig5_genus %>%
  group_by(fig5_panel, sample_name_clean) %>%
  summarise(literature_abundance = sum(abundance, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(literature_abundance > 0) %>%
  group_by(fig5_panel) %>%
  arrange(desc(literature_abundance), sample_name_clean, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  ungroup()

fig5_species_n <- species_counts$n_species[match(fig5_sample_order$sample_name_clean, species_counts$sample_name_clean)]
if (any(is.na(fig5_species_n) | fig5_species_n < MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES)) {
  stop("Figure 6 draws a sample with fewer than 2 detected species.")
}

make_fig5_panel <- function(panel_name) {
  panel_title <- fig5_sample_key %>%
    filter(fig5_panel == panel_name) %>%
    distinct(monument_display, materials_plot) %>%
    mutate(title = paste(monument_display, materials_plot, sep = "\n")) %>%
    pull(title)
  sample_levels <- fig5_sample_order %>%
    filter(fig5_panel == panel_name) %>%
    pull(sample_name_clean)
  panel_data <- fig5_genus %>%
    filter(fig5_panel == panel_name, sample_name_clean %in% sample_levels) %>%
    mutate(
      sample_name_clean = factor(sample_name_clean, levels = sample_levels),
      genus = factor(genus, levels = literature_genera)
    )
  ggplot(panel_data, aes(sample_name_clean, abundance, fill = genus)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.92) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = LITERATURE_GENUS_COLORS,
      breaks = literature_genera,
      labels = genus_labels[literature_genera],
      drop = TRUE
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%"), expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
    labs(title = panel_title, x = NULL, y = "Relative abundance (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE, base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = by_mode(13, FIG_BASE_SIZE), colour = "black"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = by_mode(14, FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE), margin = margin(r = by_mode(5, 2.5))),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = gs(0.5)),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = gs(0.5)),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(by_mode(4, 2), "pt"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, size = by_mode(14, FIG_TITLE_SIZE), lineheight = 0.95, margin = margin(t = by_mode(0, 5), b = by_mode(0, 2))),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

fig5_plot_list <- lapply(fig5_panel_order, make_fig5_panel)
names(fig5_plot_list) <- fig5_panel_order

fig5_legend_source <- ggplot(
  tibble(genus = factor(literature_genera, levels = literature_genera), x = 1, y = 1),
  aes(x, y, fill = genus)
) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = LITERATURE_GENUS_COLORS,
    breaks = literature_genera,
    labels = genus_labels[literature_genera],
    name = "Genus",
    drop = TRUE
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = by_mode(4, 5), byrow = TRUE)) +
  theme_void(base_family = FIG_FONT) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE),
    legend.text = element_text(size = by_mode(13, FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE), face = "italic"),
    legend.key.size = unit(by_mode(0.6, 0.28), "cm")
  )
fig5_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(fig5_legend_source)

fig5_bars <- patchwork::wrap_plots(fig5_plot_list, ncol = 3) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Literature-associated genera",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_TITLE_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT))
  )

fig5_upset_presence <- fig5_genus %>%
  filter(abundance > 0) %>%
  distinct(genus, fig5_panel) %>%
  mutate(present = 1L) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = fig5_panel, values_from = present, values_fill = 0L)

missing_upset_panels <- setdiff(fig5_panel_order, names(fig5_upset_presence))
if (length(missing_upset_panels) > 0) {
  for (panel_name in missing_upset_panels) fig5_upset_presence[[panel_name]] <- 0L
}

fig5_upset_df <- fig5_upset_presence %>%
  select(genus, all_of(fig5_panel_order))
upset_df <- as.data.frame(fig5_upset_df %>% select(all_of(fig5_panel_order)))
rownames(upset_df) <- fig5_upset_df$genus

# Panel B is an UpSet plot drawn with ggplot, so every axis title sits against its own axis.
# One bar per exact combination of monuments: how many literature genera are found in
# that combination and in no other monument.
upset_sets <- fig5_panel_order
upset_pattern <- apply(as.matrix(upset_df[, upset_sets, drop = FALSE]), 1, paste, collapse = "")
upset_combos <- tibble(pattern = upset_pattern) %>%
  count(pattern, name = "n_genera") %>%
  mutate(degree = str_count(pattern, "1")) %>%
  filter(degree > 0) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_genera), desc(degree), pattern) %>%
  mutate(combo = row_number())

upset_membership <- tidyr::crossing(combo = upset_combos$combo, set_index = seq_along(upset_sets)) %>%
  left_join(upset_combos, by = "combo") %>%
  mutate(member = substr(pattern, set_index, set_index) == "1")
upset_links <- upset_membership %>%
  filter(member) %>%
  group_by(combo) %>%
  summarise(y_min = min(set_index), y_max = max(set_index), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(y_max > y_min)
upset_set_sizes <- tibble(set_index = seq_along(upset_sets), n_genera = colSums(upset_df[, upset_sets, drop = FALSE]))
integer_breaks <- function(limits) {
  b <- scales::extended_breaks()(limits)
  b[b == round(b)]
}

# Everything is drawn in one ggplot whose x and y units are inches (coord_fixed), so the
# distance between an axis, its tick labels, and its title is set directly and does not
# depend on how other panels line up.
# In print mode every length below is scaled by k = 7/15, the same ratio as the text.
k <- fs(1)
n_up_cols <- nrow(upset_combos)
n_up_rows <- length(upset_sets)
UP_ROW_H <- by_mode(0.58, 0.5) * k         # height of one monument row
UP_NAMES_W <- 4.0 * k        # room for the monument names
UP_SIZE_BAR_MAX <- 1.5 * k   # length of the longest set-size bar
UP_TOP_PER_GENUS <- 1.15 * k # height of the intersection bar for one genus
if (is_print()) UP_TOP_PER_GENUS <- min(UP_TOP_PER_GENUS, 1.2 / max(upset_combos$n_genera))
UP_COL_W <- 0.38 * k         # width of one intersection column
up_sizes_x0 <- (0.35 + 0.4) * k + UP_SIZE_BAR_MAX            # right end of the set-size bars
up_matrix_x0 <- up_sizes_x0 + 0.25 * k + UP_NAMES_W + 0.2 * k  # left edge of the dot matrix
# The columns narrow only if the plot would otherwise be wider than the print page.
if (is_print()) UP_COL_W <- min(UP_COL_W, (PRINT_WIDTH_IN - up_matrix_x0 - 0.1) / n_up_cols)
up_matrix_x1 <- up_matrix_x0 + n_up_cols * UP_COL_W
up_matrix_y0 <- 1.25 * k                               # bottom of the dot matrix
up_matrix_y1 <- up_matrix_y0 + n_up_rows * UP_ROW_H
up_top_base <- up_matrix_y1 + 0.18 * k
up_top_max <- max(upset_combos$n_genera)
up_width <- up_matrix_x1 + 0.2 * k
up_height <- up_top_base + up_top_max * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS + 0.75 * k

col_x <- function(i) up_matrix_x0 + (i - 0.5) * UP_COL_W
row_y <- function(j) up_matrix_y0 + (j - 0.5) * UP_ROW_H
size_scale <- UP_SIZE_BAR_MAX / max(upset_set_sizes$n_genera)
top_ticks <- integer_breaks(c(0, up_top_max))
size_ticks <- seq(0, floor(max(upset_set_sizes$n_genera) / 10) * 10, by = 10)
top_axis_x <- up_matrix_x0 - 0.1 * k
size_axis_y <- up_matrix_y0 - 0.12 * k
up_text <- pt_to_mm(FIG_BASE_SIZE)
up_line <- gs(0.5)

p_upset <- ggplot() +
  # Row stripes
  geom_rect(
    data = tibble(j = seq(1, n_up_rows, by = 2)),
    aes(xmin = up_matrix_x0 - 0.05 * k, xmax = up_matrix_x1, ymin = row_y(j) - UP_ROW_H / 2, ymax = row_y(j) + UP_ROW_H / 2),
    fill = "grey94"
  ) +
  # Dot matrix
  geom_point(data = upset_membership, aes(col_x(combo), row_y(set_index)), colour = "grey80", size = by_mode(4, 2.1)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = upset_links,
    aes(x = col_x(combo), xend = col_x(combo), y = row_y(y_min), yend = row_y(y_max)),
    linewidth = by_mode(1.4, 0.6), colour = "grey15"
  ) +
  geom_point(data = filter(upset_membership, member), aes(col_x(combo), row_y(set_index)), colour = "grey15", size = by_mode(5, 2.7)) +
  # Monument names
  geom_text(
    data = tibble(j = seq_len(n_up_rows), label = upset_sets),
    aes(x = up_matrix_x0 - 0.15 * k, y = row_y(j), label = label), hjust = 1, size = up_text
  ) +
  # Intersection bars, with their own y axis
  geom_rect(
    data = upset_combos,
    aes(xmin = col_x(combo) - 0.65 * UP_COL_W / 2, xmax = col_x(combo) + 0.65 * UP_COL_W / 2,
        ymin = up_top_base, ymax = up_top_base + n_genera * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS),
    fill = "grey25"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = upset_combos,
    aes(x = col_x(combo), y = up_top_base + n_genera * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS + 0.04 * k, label = n_genera),
    vjust = 0, size = up_text
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = top_axis_x, xend = top_axis_x, y = up_top_base, yend = up_top_base + up_top_max * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS, linewidth = up_line) +
  annotate("segment", x = top_axis_x - 0.07 * k, xend = top_axis_x, y = up_top_base + top_ticks * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS, yend = up_top_base + top_ticks * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS, linewidth = up_line) +
  annotate("text", x = top_axis_x - 0.12 * k, y = up_top_base + top_ticks * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS, label = top_ticks, hjust = 1, size = up_text) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = top_axis_x - (0.12 + 0.2 + 0.1) * k, y = up_top_base + up_top_max * UP_TOP_PER_GENUS / 2,
    label = "Number of shared\nliterature-associated genera", angle = 90, vjust = 0, hjust = 0.5,
    size = pt_to_mm(FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE), lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  # Set-size bars, with their own x axis
  geom_rect(
    data = upset_set_sizes,
    aes(xmin = up_sizes_x0 - n_genera * size_scale, xmax = up_sizes_x0,
        ymin = row_y(set_index) - UP_ROW_H * 0.3, ymax = row_y(set_index) + UP_ROW_H * 0.3),
    fill = "grey25"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = upset_set_sizes,
    aes(x = up_sizes_x0 - n_genera * size_scale - 0.05 * k, y = row_y(set_index), label = n_genera),
    hjust = 1, size = up_text
  ) +
  annotate("segment", x = up_sizes_x0 - max(size_ticks) * size_scale, xend = up_sizes_x0, y = size_axis_y, yend = size_axis_y, linewidth = up_line) +
  annotate("segment", x = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, xend = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, y = size_axis_y, yend = size_axis_y - 0.07 * k, linewidth = up_line) +
  annotate("text", x = up_sizes_x0 - size_ticks * size_scale, y = size_axis_y - 0.12 * k, label = size_ticks, vjust = 1, size = up_text) +
  annotate(
    "text", x = up_sizes_x0 - UP_SIZE_BAR_MAX / 2, y = size_axis_y - (0.12 + 0.22 + 0.12) * k,
    label = "Literature-associated\ngenera detected", vjust = 1, hjust = 0.5,
    size = pt_to_mm(FIG_AXIS_TITLE_SIZE), lineheight = 0.95
  ) +
  annotate("text", x = 0.05 * k, y = up_height - 0.05 * k, label = "B", hjust = 0, vjust = 1, fontface = "bold", size = pt_to_mm(FIG_TAG_SIZE)) +
  coord_fixed(xlim = c(0, up_width), ylim = c(0, up_height), expand = FALSE, clip = "off") +
  theme_void(base_family = FIG_FONT) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = NA))
upset_panel <- p_upset

# Panel A: one bar chart per monument-material, with the genus legend under them.
n_fig5_panels <- length(fig5_plot_list)
fig5_bar_rows <- ceiling(n_fig5_panels / 3)
fig5_legend_rows <- ceiling(length(literature_genera) / by_mode(4, 5))
fig5_bars_height <- by_mode(1 + 4.4 * fig5_bar_rows, 0.4 + 1.65 * fig5_bar_rows)
fig5_legend_height <- by_mode(0.32 * fig5_legend_rows + 0.6, 0.125 * fig5_legend_rows + 0.3)
fig5_a_height <- fig5_bars_height + fig5_legend_height
figure6_a <- (wrap_elements(fig5_bars) / wrap_elements(fig5_legend)) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(fig5_bars_height, fig5_legend_height)) +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = list(c("A", ""))) &
  theme(plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_TAG_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT))

fig6_files <- c(
  save_panel(figure6_a, FIG6_DIR, "Figure6A_literature_genera_bars", width = 15, height = fig5_a_height),
  save_panel(upset_panel, FIG6_DIR, "Figure6B_shared_literature_genera", width = up_width, height = up_height)
)
if (is_print()) {
  figure6 <- (blk(figure6_a) / blk(upset_panel)) +
    plot_layout(heights = c(fig5_a_height, up_height))
  fig6_files <- save_page(figure6, OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure6_literature_genera", height = fig5_a_height + up_height)
}
knitr::include_graphics(fig6_files)
```

The combined figure is `paper_output/Figure6_literature_genera.pdf` and `paper_output/Figure6_literature_genera.png`. Saved panels are `paper_output/Figure6/Figure6A_literature_genera_bars.png` and `paper_output/Figure6/Figure6B_shared_literature_genera.png`.

# Figure 7. One genus heatmap per monument

A is Orpheus, B is Soldier's National Monument, and C is Monumento às Bandeiras. Each heatmap stands alone. The literature genera are read from `input/Literature_Microorganism.csv`, sheet 1 of the validated table, the same list as Figure 6. *Cutibacterium* is on that sheet but marked as not recommended, so it is not treated as a literature genus. It still appears where it is needed to reach 75% of that monument. Rows are genera kept for that monument only: a literature genus detected in its swabs, or a genus needed to reach 75% of that monument's own average abundance. Genera absent from the monument are not given a row. Columns are that monument's retained swabs, labeled without the `BC-` prefix. Genera stay in three Set blocks (both lists, only the top 75%, or only literature), ordered by mean abundance inside each block. Samples are clustered by average-linkage Euclidean distance on the same 0–1 values shown in the cells. Set, biofilm color, and the abundance scale are defined once for all three panels and drawn in one shared legend. The row bar is that Set class. The column bar is biofilm color, using the same colors on every panel; an unannotated swab is blue. Abundance is MetaPhlAn genus percent mapped onto 0–1 by `log1p(abundance) / log1p(100)`.

```{r figure7, fig.width=16, fig.height=30, out.width="100%"}
FIG7_DIR <- file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure7")
literature_genera_fig7 <- literature_genera_from_sheet(file.path(ROOT, "input", "Literature_Microorganism.csv"))
BIOFILM_COLORS <- c(
  "black" = "#1A1A1A",
  "black gray" = "#4D4D4D",
  "gray" = "#B0B0B0",
  "white" = "#F2F2F2",
  "green" = "#009E73",
  "pink" = "#CC79A7",
  "orange" = "#E69F00",
  "brown" = "#8C510A",
  "red brown" = "#A6761D",
  "rust red" = "#D55E00",
  "rust" = "#E07A3D",
  "dark rust" = "#6B2A12",
  "perl" = "#F3E6D4",
  "yellow" = "#E6C200",
  "yellow green" = "#8DB600",
  "black white" = "#5C6B73",
  "unannotated" = "#0072B2"
)

genus_rows <- metaphlan_wide %>% filter(str_detect(clade_name, "\\|g__[^|]+$"))
genus_names <- str_remove(str_extract(genus_rows$clade_name, "[^|]+$"), "^g__")
if (anyDuplicated(genus_names)) stop("Duplicate genus names in the MetaPhlAn table.")

biofilm_key <- metadata %>%
  filter(!sample_type %in% SEQUENCING_CONTROL_TYPES) %>%
  inner_join(species_counts, by = "sample_name_clean") %>%
  mutate(
    n_species = replace_na(n_species, 0L),
    monument_name = plot_label(str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(monument), "_", " "))),
    biofilm_label = plot_label(str_squish(str_replace_all(as.character(biofilm_color), "_", " ")))
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n_species >= MIN_DETECTED_SPECIES,
    monument_name %in% c("Orpheus", "Soldier's National Monument") | str_detect(monument_name, "Bandeiras"),
    sample_name_clean %in% sample_cols
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    biofilm_label = if_else(
      is.na(biofilm_label) | biofilm_label %in% c("", "NA"),
      "unannotated",
      biofilm_label
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(sample_name_clean, monument_name, biofilm_label)

unknown_biofilm <- setdiff(unique(biofilm_key$biofilm_label), names(BIOFILM_COLORS))
if (length(unknown_biofilm)) {
  stop("Unmapped biofilm colors: ", paste(unknown_biofilm, collapse = ", "))
}

genus_matrix <- t(as.matrix(genus_rows[, biofilm_key$sample_name_clean, drop = FALSE]))
storage.mode(genus_matrix) <- "numeric"
colnames(genus_matrix) <- genus_names
rownames(genus_matrix) <- biofilm_key$sample_name_clean

bandeiras_name <- biofilm_key %>%
  filter(str_detect(monument_name, "Bandeiras")) %>%
  distinct(monument_name) %>%
  pull(monument_name)
if (length(bandeiras_name) != 1) {
  stop("Expected one Bandeiras monument name, found: ", paste(bandeiras_name, collapse = ", "))
}

monument_order <- c("Orpheus", "Soldier's National Monument", bandeiras_name)
monument_ids <- split(
  biofilm_key$sample_name_clean,
  factor(biofilm_key$monument_name, levels = monument_order)
)
if (!setequal(names(monument_ids), monument_order)) {
  stop("Unexpected monuments in the heatmap: ", paste(names(monument_ids), collapse = ", "))
}

genera_covering_monument <- function(ids) {
  means <- sort(colMeans(genus_matrix[ids, , drop = FALSE]), decreasing = TRUE)
  share <- cumsum(means) / sum(means)
  n_keep <- which(share >= 0.75)[1]
  if (!is.finite(n_keep)) stop("No genera cover 75% of this monument's mean abundance.")
  names(means)[seq_len(n_keep)]
}
top_by_monument <- lapply(monument_ids, genera_covering_monument)
stopifnot(identical(
  lengths(top_by_monument[monument_order]),
  setNames(c(3L, 10L, 12L), monument_order)
))

set_colors <- c("Both" = "#882255", "Top 75%" = "#117733", "Literature" = "#332288")
heat_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#FEE6CE", "#FDAE6B", "#E6550D", "#A63603"))(100)
heat_breaks <- seq(0, 1, length.out = length(heat_colors) + 1)
scale_breaks <- c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1)
monument_titles <- setNames(monument_order, monument_order)
biofilm_global <- BIOFILM_COLORS[names(BIOFILM_COLORS) %in% unique(biofilm_key$biofilm_label)]
to_unit_scale <- function(x) pmin(log1p(pmax(x, 0)) / log1p(100), 1)
hclust_safe <- function(x) {
  if (nrow(x) < 2) return(FALSE)
  d <- dist(x)
  if (any(!is.finite(d))) return(FALSE)
  stats::hclust(d, method = "average")
}

monument_heatmap <- function(mon_name, tag) {
  ids <- monument_ids[[mon_name]]
  top <- top_by_monument[[mon_name]]
  present <- intersect(literature_genera_fig7, colnames(genus_matrix))
  detected <- present[colSums(genus_matrix[ids, present, drop = FALSE]) > 0]
  means <- colMeans(genus_matrix[ids, , drop = FALSE])
  order_by_mean <- function(genera) genera[order(means[genera], decreasing = TRUE)]
  both <- order_by_mean(intersect(top, detected))
  top_only <- order_by_mean(setdiff(top, detected))
  literature_only <- order_by_mean(setdiff(detected, top))
  genus_order <- c(both, top_only, literature_only)
  genus_set <- c(
    rep("Both", length(both)),
    rep("Top 75%", length(top_only)),
    rep("Literature", length(literature_only))
  )
  sample_lab <- str_remove(ids, "^BC-")
  heat_mat <- t(to_unit_scale(genus_matrix[ids, genus_order, drop = FALSE]))
  rownames(heat_mat) <- str_replace_all(genus_order, "_", " ")
  colnames(heat_mat) <- sample_lab
  row_annotation <- data.frame(
    Set = factor(genus_set, levels = names(set_colors)),
    row.names = rownames(heat_mat),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  col_annotation <- data.frame(
    `Biofilm color` = factor(
      biofilm_key$biofilm_label[match(ids, biofilm_key$sample_name_clean)],
      levels = names(biofilm_global)
    ),
    row.names = sample_lab,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  heat_args <- list(
    mat = heat_mat,
    silent = TRUE,
    scale = "none",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = hclust_safe(t(heat_mat)),
    color = heat_colors,
    breaks = heat_breaks,
    annotation_row = row_annotation,
    annotation_col = col_annotation,
    annotation_colors = list(Set = set_colors, `Biofilm color` = biofilm_global),
    annotation_names_row = FALSE,
    annotation_names_col = FALSE,
    legend = FALSE,
    annotation_legend = FALSE,
    border_color = "grey92",
    fontsize = FIG_BASE_SIZE,
    fontsize_row = FIG_BASE_SIZE,
    fontsize_col = by_mode(11, 5.5),
    cellwidth = by_mode(22, max(7, min(12, floor(360 / length(ids))))),
    cellheight = by_mode(20, 6.5),
    angle_col = 90,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = by_mode(40, 14),
    main = paste0(tag, "  ", monument_titles[[mon_name]])
  )
  genus_sizes <- c(length(both), length(top_only), length(literature_only))
  genus_sizes <- genus_sizes[genus_sizes > 0]
  if (length(genus_sizes) > 1) heat_args$gaps_row <- cumsum(genus_sizes)[-length(genus_sizes)]
  list(gtable = do.call(pheatmap::pheatmap, heat_args)$gtable, n = length(genus_order))
}

fig7_shared_legend <- function() {
  theme_leg <- theme_void(base_size = FIG_BASE_SIZE, base_family = FIG_FONT) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = FIG_LEGEND_TITLE_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT),
      legend.text = element_text(size = FIG_LEGEND_TEXT_SIZE, family = FIG_FONT),
      legend.key.size = unit(by_mode(0.45, 0.28), "cm"),
      legend.box.margin = margin(0, 4, 0, 4)
    )
  p_ab <- ggplot(data.frame(x = 1, y = 1, z = 0.5), aes(x, y, fill = z)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_gradientn(colours = heat_colors, limits = c(0, 1), breaks = scale_breaks, name = "Abundance") +
    guides(fill = guide_colourbar(barwidth = unit(by_mode(3.2, 2.1), "cm"), barheight = unit(by_mode(0.45, 0.28), "cm"), title.position = "top")) +
    theme_leg
  p_set <- ggplot(data.frame(Set = factor(names(set_colors), names(set_colors))), aes(Set, 1, fill = Set)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = set_colors, name = "Set", drop = FALSE) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1, title.position = "top")) +
    theme_leg
  p_bio <- ggplot(data.frame(Color = factor(names(biofilm_global), names(biofilm_global))), aes(Color, 1, fill = Color)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = biofilm_global, name = "Biofilm color", drop = FALSE) +
    guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, title.position = "top", override.aes = list(colour = "grey55", linewidth = 0.2))) +
    theme_leg
  gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    cowplot::get_legend(p_ab),
    cowplot::get_legend(p_set),
    cowplot::get_legend(p_bio),
    ncol = 3,
    widths = grid::unit(c(1.15, 1.2, 2.4), "null")
  )
}

heatmap_a <- monument_heatmap("Orpheus", "A")
heatmap_b <- monument_heatmap("Soldier's National Monument", "B")
heatmap_c <- monument_heatmap(bandeiras_name, "C")
fig7_legend <- fig7_shared_legend()

panel_size_in <- function(gt) {
  grDevices::pdf(NULL)
  on.exit(grDevices::dev.off())
  c(
    width = grid::convertWidth(sum(gt$widths), "in", valueOnly = TRUE),
    height = grid::convertHeight(sum(gt$heights), "in", valueOnly = TRUE)
  )
}
save_heatmap <- function(heat, file_name) {
  size <- panel_size_in(heat$gtable)
  save_panel(heat$gtable, FIG7_DIR, file_name, width = size[["width"]] + 0.4, height = size[["height"]] + 0.4)
}

fig7_files <- c(
  save_heatmap(heatmap_a, "Figure7A_orpheus_genus_heatmap"),
  save_heatmap(heatmap_b, "Figure7B_soldiers_national_monument_genus_heatmap"),
  save_heatmap(heatmap_c, "Figure7C_monumento_as_bandeiras_genus_heatmap")
)

if (is_print()) {
  hs <- vapply(
    list(heatmap_a, heatmap_b, heatmap_c),
    function(h) panel_size_in(h$gtable)[["height"]] + 0.06,
    numeric(1)
  )
  legend_h <- 0.72
  page_h <- sum(hs) + legend_h
  if (page_h > PRINT_MAX_HEIGHT_IN) {
    hs <- hs * (PRINT_MAX_HEIGHT_IN - legend_h) / sum(hs)
    page_h <- PRINT_MAX_HEIGHT_IN
  }
  page <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
    grobs = list(heatmap_a$gtable, heatmap_b$gtable, heatmap_c$gtable, fig7_legend),
    ncol = 1,
    heights = grid::unit(c(hs, legend_h), "in")
  )
  fig7_files <- save_page(page, OUTPUT_DIR, "Figure7_biofilm_genera", height = page_h)
}
knitr::include_graphics(fig7_files)
```

The combined figure is one page, `paper_output/Figure7_biofilm_genera.pdf` and `paper_output/Figure7_biofilm_genera.png`. Saved panels are `paper_output/Figure7/Figure7A_orpheus_genus_heatmap.png`, `paper_output/Figure7/Figure7B_soldiers_national_monument_genus_heatmap.png`, and `paper_output/Figure7/Figure7C_monumento_as_bandeiras_genus_heatmap.png`.

# A4 print pages of the combined figures

The figures above are the check panels: each panel is saved on its own, large, in `paper_output/Figure1/` to `paper_output/Figure7/`. The combined files are these A4 portrait pages, built for Nature Cities: at most 180 mm wide, Helvetica text between 5 and 7 pt (axis and title text 7 pt, legends 6 pt, panel letters 8 pt bold), PNG at 600 dpi, and a vector PDF. The code is the same as above, run again with the print style.

```{r print-mode}
set_figure_mode("print")
```
